name: What electrical upgrades are needed for garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What electrical upgrades are needed for garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Receptacles every 6 ft along walls, dedicated circuits for lights/fans, AFCI protection, and often a subpanel upgrade to handle residential loads; GFCI outlets near sinks/water sources.
